projects.name: DataViz Pro: AI-Powered Business Intelligence Platform
projects.description: Production-ready microservices platform enabling non-technical users to query datasets and generate visualizations using LLM technology
highlights: Architected production-ready microservices platform with 4 independent services (Next.js TypeScript frontend, Python LangGraph backend, Node.js SQLite server, Flask API) handling 1MB+ file uploads across 14+ database tables.
Developed intelligent SQL generation system using GPT-4/Gemini APIs and LangGraph multi-agent framework, achieving 95%+ query accuracy through context-aware parsing and schema validation.

projects.name: Yoga Pose Classification System
projects.description: End-to-end computer vision pipeline that classifies 107 distinct yoga poses from live video stream
highlights: Built and deployed an end-to-end computer vision pipeline that classifies 107 distinct yoga poses from a live video stream, achieving approximately 75% accuracy on a 5.6k image test dataset

projects.name: Hybrid Movie Recommendation Engine
projects.description: Dual-model recommendation system combining content-based filtering and popularity-based algorithms
highlights: Architected a hybrid recommendation engine combining content-based filtering and popularity-based model to deliver robust suggestions for 45,000+ movies, effectively mitigating the cold-start problem for new users.
Utilized Scikit-learn to build a TF-IDF vectorizer, transforming movie metadata into a 5,000-dimensional feature space for calculating content similarity with 85%+ recommendation accuracy.
Implemented collaborative filtering algorithms processing user-movie interaction matrices to generate personalized recommendations for diverse user preferences.

projects.name: GitHubFetch CLI Tool
projects.description: Open-source Python CLI tool for viewing stylized GitHub profiles in terminal, published on PyPI
highlights: Developed and published `githubfetch` on PyPI with 500+ downloads, a Python CLI tool for viewing stylized GitHub profiles directly in the terminal, inspired by system fetch tools like neofetch.
Engineered the tool to query GitHub GraphQL and REST APIs, parsing JSON data to display user info, pinned repositories, and horizontal contribution heatmap with 99.9% API reliability.
Implemented robust error handling and caching mechanisms to ensure seamless user experience across different network conditions and API rate limits.

Implemented secure multi-user authentication and data isolation, ensuring privacy and data integrity for personal financial information.
